typography.notes: Use tracking-tight for headings. H1 max text-5xl to text-6xl. Use variable weights to add elegance.

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8, py-20, py-32 for sections.
layout.border_radius: Subtle rounded corners (rounded-lg to rounded-2xl) to mimic organic softness, but not overly pill-shaped.

components.buttons: Shadcn based. Primary: bg-[#E5A93D] text-[#2C1E16] hover:bg-[#D48B1B] font-medium tracking-wide. Secondary: border border-[#E5A93D] text-[#2C1E16] hover:bg-[#E5A93D]/10.
components.cards: Flat surfaces with subtle 1px border (#E5DCC5), no heavy shadows. hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300. bg-white or bg-[#FDFBF7]
components.header: Sticky with Glassmorphism: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#E5DCC5].
components.inputs: Shadcn input/textarea but customized with rounded-md, border-[#E5DCC5], focus:ring-[#E5A93D].

sections.name: Hero
sections.design: Full height (min-h-[90vh]). Background image with cinematic gradient overlay to ensure text contrast. Overlay: bg-black/40. Text aligned left or center with generous leading.

content.title: Prirodni med direktno iz košnice
content.subtitle: Kvalitetan domaći med i pčelinji proizvodi iz porodičnog pčelarstva.

sections.name: About
sections.design: Asymmetric bento/grid layout. Large image of beekeeper and smaller image of honeycomb overlapping. High negative space.

sections.name: Products
sections.design: 3-column grid for desktop. Cardless look or subtle border cards. Product image on top with light background behind it.

sections.name: Benefits
sections.design: Grid of small info cards with Lucide icons (Leaf, Heart, Sun, Droplet, Shield). Colors: #E5A93D icons.

sections.name: Gallery
sections.design: Bento grid of 4-5 images. Use mixed aspect ratios (tall, wide, square). Gap-4 or gap-6.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.design: Simple elegant quotes. Use italic Cormorant Garamond for the quote text.

sections.name: Contact
sections.design: Two columns: Contact info (Address, Phone, Email, Insta) on left, Form on right.

technical_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-buy')
technical_instructions.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratio on text over images. Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons.
